blocks.text: Marian Rivera has been recognized as one of the top taxpayers of the Bureau of Internal Revenue’s (BIR) Revenue District Office 041 in Mandaluyong City. The BIR RDO 41-Mandaluyong City recognized Rivera as one of its “Natatanging Taxpayers” during a ceremony on Oct. 1, according to a post on the district office’s official Facebook page. “RDO 41–Mandaluyong City proudly honors Ms. Marian Rivera as one of its Natatanging Taxpayers for her valuable contribution to nation-building through responsible tax compliance,” the BIR said. Photos shared by the agency showed Rivera receiving a plaque from BIR officials. The plaque cited Rivera as one […]...
